criteria.requirement: Implement charset_normalizer.streams.from_stream(stream, *, max_bytes, read_size=65536, preserve_position=True, **options). Never read(-1), retain at most the explicit nonnegative budget, handle short reads and report actual read_bytes/eof/budget_exhausted with real from_bytes matches. Restore seekable caller positions even on errors and never close caller streams; nonseekable preservation/text reads/invalid bounds fail clearly. Zero budget must not read, and a limited prefix must not be represented as whole-source validation.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
